SELECT A.EPISODE AS LocalDateTimeEpisode, B.USER_ID AS userId, A.LOCATION AS location FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) B ON A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE WHERE A.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'N'
AND A.EPISODE > DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 4 HOUR) ORDER BY A.EPISODE ASC

SELECT A.SEX AS sex, B.JOB_DIVISION AS jobDivision, A.EPISODE AS episode, YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(B.BIRTHDAY) AS year, C.LOCATION location FROM PARTICIPANT_USER A INNER JOIN USER_TABLE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID INNER JOIN MEETING_SCHEDULE C ON A.EPISODE = C.EPISODE WHERE A.EPISODE IN ( SELECT EPISODE FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE WHERE 1=1 AND EPISODE > NOW() ) ORDER BY A.CREATETIME ASC

SELECT A.USER_ID AS pickedUserId, NICKNAME nickName, B.PICK pick, A.EPISODE AS localDateTimeEpisode FROM PARTICIPANT_USER A
LEFT OUTER JOIN
(SELECT * FROM MATCHING A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}) B ON A.NICKNAME = B.PICK AND A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE
WHERE SEX <> ( SELECT SEX FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) AND A.EPISODE = (SELECT AA.EPISODE FROM ( SELECT EPISODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS ROWNUM FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -5 HOUR) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -1 HOUR) ORDER BY EPISODE DESC )AA WHERE AA.ROWNUM =1 )

SELECT AA.PICK AS nickName, CC.PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber FROM ( SELECT USER_ID, PICK, PICKED_USER FROM MATCHING WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} AND EPISODE IN
(SELECT EPISODE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -14 HOUR) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -2 HOUR)) ) AA INNER JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID FROM MATCHING WHERE PICKED_USER =#{userId} AND EPISODE IN (SELECT EPISODE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -14 HOUR) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -2 HOUR)) ) BB ON AA.PICKED_USER = BB.USER_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, PHONE_NUMBER FROM USER_TABLE ) CC ON AA.PICKED_USER = CC.USER_ID

SELECT A.NICKNAME nickName FROM PARTICIPANT_USER A INNER JOIN USER_TABLE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE A.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM MATCHING WHERE PICKED_USER = #{userId} AND EPISODE IN (SELECT EPISODE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -14 hour) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -2 hour))
) AND EPISODE IN (SELECT EPISODE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -14 hour) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -2 hour))

SELECT USER_ID FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(#{LocalDateTimeEpisode}, INTERVAL -5 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(#{LocalDateTimeEpisode}, INTERVAL -1 HOUR) AND SEX = '남성'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARTICIPANT_USER(USER_ID, EPISODE, SEX, NICKNAME) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{episode}, (SELECT SEX FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}), ( SELECT VALUE1 FROM ( SELECT VALUE1 FROM CRITERIA_DATA WHERE DIVISION = ( SELECT CASE WHEN SEX = '남성' THEN 'male_nickname' ELSE 'female_nickname' END FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) AND VALUE1 NOT IN ( SELECT NICKNAME FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE EPISODE = #{episode} ) ORDER BY LENGTH(VALUE1), VALUE1 LIMIT 1 ) AS AA ) )
